notes: Scope is the main school slab and its saw-tooth wing (BAG pand 0363100012121682). The neighbouring pand 0363100012195030 (the low courtyard complex, address 1A) is not replaced. The photographed slab faces are gently curved in plan; the BAG/3DBAG outline is straight, so the model is straight. The south face is mostly hidden by trees in all panoramas, so its ribbon pitch (about 2 m) is carried over from the north face. Porch and pavilion positions on the wing's east face are estimated from the bearing of the court panoramas (about 2-3 m uncertain). Pane pitch and the ribbon heights were measured by eye.
